summary: chibisafe is a self-hosted file upload + sharing service (Fastify + Prisma/SQLite backend). Users upload files (local/S3, optional quarantine + thumbnails), organize them in albums with tags, share albums via short links, share code snippets, and shorten URLs; admins manage users, files, IP bans, invites, and instance settings.
